title: Java House - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
Why Guests Love Staying at The Java House-

✨ Sleeps 10 comfortably – 5 spacious bedrooms 🚋 Free Trolley to the Beach & Seacrest 🚲 4 Adult Bikes and 1 child (16 inch) included 🎶 Walk to Peddlers Pavilion – Just steps away in Seacrest, enjoy live music, family-friendly events, dining, and shopping all season long. 🐾 Pet-Friendly (fee applies) 👶 Pack n Play and High Chair Included 🌊 Short walk to beach access 🏖️ Beach gear included — chairs, umbrellas, beach towels and a cooler 🏊 Access to the 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon-style community pool 🌅 Private rooftop deck with sunset views & lounge seating 🔥 Large propane grill for family cookouts 🚿 Outdoor shower for easy beach clean-up 🪑 Covered front porch with charming rocking chairs 👑 Two King suites for ultimate comfort 🧺 Laundry area with front-load washer & dryer 📍 Prime location just off Scenic 30A 🏢 Professionally managed by 30A Five Star Properties with 24/7 support

Located along beautiful Scenic Highway 30A, Seacrest Beach is one of the most sought-after communities on 30A. Known for its relaxed coastal charm, pastel beach homes, and walkable layout, Seacrest offers the perfect blend of convenience and serenity.

Guests enjoy: 🏊 One of the largest lagoon-style pools on 30A 🚶 Easy beach access 🚲 Scenic bike paths connecting you to nearby communities 🍽️ Close proximity to boutique shopping and local dining

It’s the ideal setting for families who want everything within reach — without the crowds.

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS

FIRST FLOOR: -Half bathroom off Kitchen

SECOND FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo

THIRD FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with shared bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed with shared bathroom with Shower - Twin bunk bed with shared bathroom with Shower

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens

IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation. *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
